title: An easy unloaded bend still needs actual phase writing and retained load paths
statement: A separate unloaded 300 mm quarter-circle of radius 190.986 mm needs 6.99790 mm outer-to-inner foil length difference. Equal end bonding does not freely provide arbitrary curvature; controlled slip, feed or excess length needs a real route. Freely sliding introduced foils have strain 6.54498e-5, stress 13.090 MPa, moment .00272708 N m and energy .00214184 J. That offers a low-force forming scale, not yield, fatigue, torsion, wrinkle, normal-contact, end-feed or retained-geometry qualification. Jamming must resist springback and useful load; loaded release needs another load path and energy capture. A shared writer, persistent addressable lock and economical reconfiguration remain unconstructed.
